data.title: 20 hours of work on 9-min charge: New Digit 5 humanoid robot unveiled
data.description: The Digit 5 humanoid lifts 50 pounds, charges in nine minutes and uses new safety systems to work alongside warehouse employees.
data.author: Atharva Gosavi
data.keywords: Agility, Agility Robotics, Digit humanoid robot, Humanoid Robot, Inventions and Machines, robots, US, Warehouse Robot
